correctness.rationale: For negative beta, the exact RH_s membership of |x|^beta is beta*s>-n; substituting s=q'/2 into the primary real-coefficient equivalence gives q>2n/(2n+beta). The local-finiteness condition for mu_{q'} has the same strict threshold, proving equality of the infimum. Nonnegative beta lies in RH_infinity and gives p_-=1. The adjoint has the same weight and real structure, so the source duality corollary yields the stated explicit reverse range. The critical Sobolev power follows by exact algebra and its endpoint RH failure by |x|^{-n} nonintegrability.

Solving the abstract reverse-Hölder condition gives a complete exact phase diagram for its central lower exponent, identifies the threshold with the dual-measure integrability wall, and exposes the critical Sobolev boundary beta=-n^2/(n+2), where the endpoint sufficient RH condition fails although p_-=2_*.
